claim_boundary: Primary research reports that economic policy uncertainty can predict Bitcoin returns and that increases in newspaper-based uncertainty have sometimes predicted higher Bitcoin returns. This does not establish that a lagged weekly US EPU state improves DRA V1 economics. Exactly one frozen matched-capital historical screen may test the primary prior-52-week median relation with fixed 0.80 and 1.20 ratio neighbors. Any source-timing, economic, breadth, drawdown, holding, inventory or neighbor failure closes the family without changing direction, aggregation, lag, thresholds, parent or accounting.

feature_contract.formula: For each complete Monday-through-Sunday UTC week, average the seven positive USEPUINDXD observations. After a conservative seven-calendar-day publication lag, divide that weekly mean by the median of the immediately preceding fifty-two non-overlapping complete weekly means.

prior_matrix.finding: The peer-reviewed study reports that time-series momentum, economic policy uncertainty and financial uncertainty outperform other Bitcoin-return predictors in in-sample, out-of-sample and asset-allocation tests.
prior_matrix.identity: Cheah, Luo, Zhang and Sung, Predictability of bitcoin returns, European Journal of Finance 28(1), 66-85 (2022)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Forecast-model performance does not validate this weekly aggregation, median ratio, DRA entry timing, threshold direction or trading economics.

prior_matrix.finding: The study reports that increases in a newspaper-based economic uncertainty measure tend to predict higher Bitcoin returns and finds Bitcoin to be a hedge against newspaper- and search-based uncertainty measures in monthly data.
prior_matrix.identity: Bouri and Gupta, Predicting Bitcoin returns: Comparing the roles of newspaper- and internet search-based measures of uncertainty, Finance Research Letters 38, 101398 (2021)
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: Monthly predictive regressions do not prove a weekly US-only DRA admission rule or stability after costs.

prior_matrix.finding: FRED defines USEPUINDXD as a daily seven-day news-based US Economic Policy Uncertainty index sourced from Baker, Bloom and Davis.
prior_matrix.identity: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED, USEPUINDXD
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The current FRED history is a present-vintage series and does not prove original release timestamps or unrevised historical values.

real_time_design_requirements: Seal one exact create-once official no-key FRED CSV response before opening BTC outcomes.
Use only complete seven-observation Monday-through-Sunday weeks and apply the conservative seven-calendar-day availability lag.
Freeze primary 1.00 with 0.80 and 1.20 ratio neighbors and relation AT_OR_ABOVE.
Keep DRA side, entries, exits, lot cost, capacity, fees, adverse slippage, cooldown and fill clock unchanged.

Require matched-capital Design and Validation PnL, realized and unrealized decomposition, drawdown, underwater duration, holding distribution, terminal inventory, intervention support, annual breadth, concentration and both-neighbor stability.
Treat present-vintage source timing as historical development evidence only; do not open post-2024 OOS or claim a hedge from aggregate PnL.
uncertainty: The literature is not unanimous across countries, uncertainty definitions or samples; a US weekly positive relation may fail.
The news-composition index can change meaning across elections, wars, pandemics and policy regimes.
The current FRED series is present-vintage; original daily release timestamps and revisions remain MISSING_PROOF.
No BTC strategy outcome, post-2024 evidence, OOS, candidate, canonical write or Trading action was accessed while freezing this prior.
